description: Ding Feng, sturdy chinese soldier in the supplied pixel art style. A red cloth head wrap with tails, grey armor with red trim, a red sash, dark boots. He holds a short curved blade in the right hand
face: A short dark beard and steady eyes.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the red head wrap with its tails, grey armor with red trim, the short blade at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the sword up in front of the body, the left hand stays free as a guard, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the sword, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a2: One rising cut from low to high. Frames 1-5 lower the sword and coil; frame 8 the upward cut lands; frames 9-11 the sword finishes high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The short curved blade stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Thrust, then rising cut. Frames 1-5 draw back; frame 6 a straight thrust; frames 7-8 the sword drops low; frame 9 a rising cut; frames 10-11 the sword finishes high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The short curved blade stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Leaping downward cut. Frames 1-4 crouch and raise the sword; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground; frame 8 he lands cutting straight down; frames 9-11 absorb the landing. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The short curved blade stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s3: Low wide sweep. Frames 1-6 both knees fold and the sword is drawn far behind; frame 8 one broad level sweep at waist height from right to left; frames 9-12 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The short curved blade stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 a2 → b2 → b3, 전법 s3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
